import RNA,random

def vary(seq):

    for i in [0]+list(range(6,14))+[27,28]+list(range(33,40)):
        s[i]=random.choice('ACGU')
    return ''.join(s)
base='AGGGGGAAAAAAAACGGGGAAAACCCCAACCCCAAAAAAA'
best_gap=999;best=None

    fc=RNA.fold_compound(seq)

    ea=fc.eval_structure(alt)
